events.title: RE-EXTINCTION STREAM: KILL ALL DINOS!
events.summary: Hi I'm the DEVELOPER of this game "DinoSWORD". I saw "Dinoblade" recently and thought it was the coolest thing I've ever seen so I wanted to make my own. Hope you enjoy watching me make some gasoline all week for NEXTFEST as I will be running the game off and on over the next few days. So come watch me become the king of the prehistoric jungle and give THE DEMO for DINOSWORD a play for FREE today!

events.title: PRE-NEXTFEST DEVELOPER GAMEPLAY TEST!
events.summary: Testing the streaming feature - never did it before, just trying to establish connections before STREAMING THE GAME for NextFest! I'll answer questions too!

events.title: NEW adventure mode SCREENSHOTS!
events.summary: New screenshots from the ADVENTURE MODE featured in the game DINOSWORD! There is an adventure mode for each CLASS, those classes being: The MINION, the FLYER, the CHARGER, the ARMORED, the TYRANT, and the BEHEMOTH. Here are some moments captured from their respective adventures, note that within each CLASS there is the option to select different SPECIES. So the options range far beyond what is depicted in these screens!

events.title: No one out parries the TYRANT KING
events.summary: Furthering the "PARRY" attacks. This one works for the TYRANT class by knocking the opponent straight up into the air, allowing for you to do DAMAGE on the way down!

events.title: DinoSWORD - new trailer!
events.summary: DinoSWORD is developing along nicely! I've begun to add in some PARRY attacks that are specific to each type of dinosaur. I wanted these moves to have elements that reflect the nature of the chess piece the dinosaur represents. For example, the CHARGER class (Bishops) are meant to be played as a living BATTERING RAM, so the PARRY ATTACK is a forward slamming charge attack that blast the opponent backwards away from the player, good for KNOCKING OPPONENTS INTO STAGE HAZZARDS! events.title: DinoSWORD Update #2: Blocking
events.summary: The dinosaurs can now BLOCK attacks! The ability to time the block correctly and initiate a "parry" maneuver is the next task. Along with blocking, the game features some additions like the PAUSE MENU which can be accessed at any point, stopping the action and providing access to a couple of options. events.title: DinoSWORD update #1
events.summary: DinoSWORD update! The game is coming along really well so far, up until this point the main focus was in setting up a repeatable gameplay loop. Rough was fine, but it all had to be there: setting up your roster, triggering a fight when 2 pieces collided, and smoothly transitioning from boardgame to fight and back again.
